findings.status: new (not in baseline; not on the 3 key pages)
findings.title: DashboardSidebar active-item button fails color contrast on /weeks and /search
findings.location: web/src/components/DashboardSidebar.tsx:33-37,46-52 (the 'My Work'/'Overview' toggle's active state: `bg-accent/10 text-accent font-medium`)
findings.evidence: axe color-contrast (Serious): weeks_board.json and search.json each report 1 node, `.bg-accent\/10`, fgColor #005ea2 / bgColor #0c151c, contrastRatio 2.74 vs required 4.5:1. Lighthouse corroborates: /weeks and /search each score 95 with color-contrast as the SOLE failing audit (compare-phase2-jul30/lighthouse/{weeks,search}.report.json).
findings.hypothesis: Read web/src/pages/App.tsx:152-178 (getActiveMode()): /weeks and /search match none of the explicit path branches and fall through to the `return 'dashboard'` default at line 178, which mounts <DashboardSidebar/> as the contextual sidebar (App.tsx:527-528). Per the A11Y-5/6/7 fix commit (e813117), /weeks and /search were previously DEAD routes with no page component and no catch-all — an unmatched path rendered nothing, so DashboardSidebar was never mounted there and this pre-existing contrast defect was unreachable. Adding real routes for these paths (to fix A11Y-5) makes them fall into the same default-mode branch as truly-unmatched paths, mounting DashboardSidebar for the first time on these URLs and exposing the defect. NOTE: this mechanism is derived from reading App.tsx's routing logic, not confirmed by a code author; flagged as hypothesis, not fact. An open, unresolved observation: manual inspection found the identical button (same classes, same computed rgba(0,94,162,0.1) background, same DOM ancestor chain, same bounding rect) IS also rendered on /my-week — yet axe reports 0 violations there in both the full-page scan and a scope-restricted re-check. The mechanism for why /my-week's structurally-identical instance does not also fail was not resolved (axe's pass/violation node lists for /my-week do not reference the DashboardSidebar button at all, in either direction) — reported as an open question rather than asserted.
findings.estimatedImpact: Low-vision users cannot read the active-view label on the only two navigable states currently rendering it; also a Section 508 contradiction on these two pages, structurally identical to the already-fixed A11Y-3. Fix: same remedy as A11Y-3 — raise bg-accent/10+text-accent to meet 4.5:1, or reuse whatever token A11Y-3 introduced.
